 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"privilege"** means a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार)

 
 
• **Example:** Having access to quality education is considered a** privilege** in many parts of the world.
 
 
 
• **"Privilege"** is the correct spelling and is used to denote a special right or advantage. (विशेषाधिकार)
 
 
• **Example:** It is a **privilege** to be able to travel and experience different cultures.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Privelege** (प्राइवलेज): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "privilege".

 
 
• **Example:** The word "privelege" does not exist in the English language.
 
 
 
• **Priviledge** (प्रिविलेज): This is another incorrect spelling of the word "privilege".
 
 
• **Example:** The word "priviledge" is often misspelled but incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Privileg** (प्रिविलग): This is also an incorrect spelling of the word "privilege".
 
 
• **Example:** The word "privileg" is not recognized as a correct spelling.
